notes: Flat (non-diarized) transcript. Doubles as a regression test for a metadata-leak bug found running v4 live on this call: 'Homeland' never appears in the spoken transcript, only in clientName — v4 pulled it into sites anyway from the 'Call with X on Y' preamble line in render.ts, violating rule 1 (extract only what was said). expected.sites is deliberately [] to catch this regressing. Flagged for a v5 fix clarifying that the preamble line is context, not extractable content — not yet made.
